description:
Retrieves real-time presence information.
      Use 'channels'/'channelGroups' for HereNow (occupancy/users in channel) and/or 'uuid' for WhereNow (channels a user is in).
      Returns presence data in JSON format. Requires publish and subscribe keys from your PubNub keyset.

channelGroups.description: List of channel group names (strings) to query presence data for

channels.description: List of channel names (strings) to query presence data for

publishKey.description: Publish Key that can be obtained from your keyset by manage_keysets tool with parameter operation list or in PubNub admin portal

subscribeKey.description: Subscribe Key that can be obtained from your keyset by manage_keysets tool with parameter operation list or in PubNub admin portal

uuid.description: UUID to query channel subscriptions for (WhereNow)

name: get_pubnub_presence
title: Get Presence Data (HereNow / WhereNow)
